home.title: Radio Atlantida
home.intro: This is the station management panel. Use the navigation to build the library, playlists, and play rules, and to configure the station.

alerts.panelError: The panel had an unexpected error.

settings.reconnectNotice: Saved. The new value takes effect when the connection is opened again. Changing the stream server briefly interrupts the stream.
settings.title: Settings

reconnect.title: Save and reconnect?
reconnect.message: These settings take effect when their connection is opened again: {settings}. Changing the stream server briefly interrupts the stream.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.note: Set in the server environment and changed by a restart, never in the panel.

errors.unsupported: This browser cannot play the audio format of "{title}".
errors.not_found: The audio file of "{title}" was not found.
errors.failed: "{title}" could not be played. Try again.

errors.step: Enter a number between {min} and {max}, in steps of {step}.
errors.timeOfDay: Enter a time as HH:MM, from 00:00 to 23:59.
errors.weekdays: Choose days from Monday to Sunday.
errors.bothOrNone: Fill in both fields or leave both empty.
errors.atLeastOne: Set at least one of these fields.
errors.pattern: The value does not have the expected form.
errors.relativePath: Enter a path inside the media folder, such as music/song.mp3: no leading /, no drive letter, no \, and no ..
errors.fallbackSource: Choose the playlist or artist for this mode.
errors.dateRange: Choose a last date on or after the first one, at most {days} days in all.

serverErrors.unique: The list contains the same item twice.

serverErrors.does_not_fit: It does not fit into the available time.
serverErrors.order: The values are in the wrong order.
serverErrors.blocked: A separation or play rule blocks this choice.

dialog.title: The clock "{clock}" is short
dialog.intro: Choose how to fill each short segment. Short segments: {count}.
dialog.poolNote: Pool tracks are used in this order. Leave the list empty to keep the clock's current pool.

delete.title: Delete "{name}"?
delete.message: "{name}" will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.message: Your changes on this page are not saved. If you leave now, they are lost.

dialog.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter. Cannot be changed later.

dialog.title: Separation: {scope}
dialog.retentionNote: At most {hours} hours: separation is checked against the aired history, which is kept for the play log retention period (Settings).

edit.limitsNote: Set at least one limit. Every limit you set must pass for the track to play. Times are station time.
edit.weekdaysNote: No day chosen means every day. With a window that crosses midnight (22:00 to 02:00), the day is the one on which the window starts.

errors.atLeastOne: Set at least one limit: a time window, weekdays, a minimum interval, or plays per hour.
errors.sameWindow: The window must end at a different time than it starts.

explain.format: the file format is not the broadcast format. Optimize track converts it.
explain.sample_rate: the sample rate is not the broadcast sample rate. Optimize track converts it.
explain.channels: the number of channels is not the broadcast standard. Optimize track converts it.
explain.loudness: the loudness is outside the tolerance around the station loudness. Fix loudness or Optimize track corrects it.
explain.true_peak: the peaks are above the allowed limit. Fix loudness or Optimize track corrects them.
explain.low_bitrate: the source was encoded below the minimum bitrate. A fix cannot restore lost detail; replace the source file.
explain.file_missing: the file is not in the media folder. Put it back or correct the file path.

edit.filePathHint: Relative to the media folder, with forward slashes, for example music/song.mp3.
edit.durationEmpty: Left empty, the length is read from the file. A track without a length cannot be planned.
edit.qualityOverride: Quality OK (your choice, until the next analysis)

media.title: Analysis and fixes
media.selectAll: Select every track on the page

outputs.copy: Optimal copy next to the original

media.tooMany: At most {max} tracks at once. Select fewer.
media.lowBitrate: Tracks with a low bitrate: {count}. No fix can restore it; replace the source file.
media.missing: Tracks with a missing file: {count}. Put the file back or correct the path.
media.saveFirst: Save or undo your changes first.

replaceDialog.title: Replace the original files?
replaceDialog.message: The fixed files replace the originals of {count} tracks. The originals are deleted from the media folder and cannot be restored.

tracks.label: Tracks in this playlist ({count})
tracks.poolNote: A playlist is a pool: the order of its tracks does not matter, and the system chooses the track.
tracks.filter: Filter the tracks of this playlist
tracks.more: {count} more tracks are not shown. Use the filter to find them.

edit.elementsNote: The order of flow elements is the order of play. Start and end elements open and close the hour; fixed elements start at their minute.

element.title: Element {number}
element.defaultTolerance: Empty: the default from the settings

check.title: Dry check
check.incompleteNote: A short segment has no filler. Reminders are created for its hours until you choose one.
check.shortfall: The clock is short by {duration} in total.
check.replaced: These fixed elements were replaced by a new element at the same time:

warnings.element_no_tracks: Element {element}: its playlists have no track with a known duration.
warnings.element_no_fitting_track: Element {element}: no track fits the nominal duration within the tolerance.
warnings.element_few_tracks: Element {element}: too few fitting tracks for the separation rules; tracks may repeat or be skipped.
warnings.element_blocked_by_play_rules: Element {element}: play rules block every fitting track in these grid hours: {hours}.
warnings.segment_overflow: Segment {segment} runs past the end of the hour; the last track is cut and faded out.

layout.title: Layout of the hour (nominal durations)
layout.stale: This is the layout as saved. Save to check your changes.
layout.caption: Segments of the hour

pool.title: Filler pool
pool.note: Specific tracks used one after another when a segment in pool mode needs filler. Used tracks stay listed as history.

week.title: Week from {from} to {to}
week.note: Hours and dates are in the station timezone ({zone}). Use + in a cell to add its weekday and hour to the change below.
week.caption: Clocks by hour for the week

change.title: Change the grid
change.note: The clock is assigned to every chosen weekday at every chosen hour, for the dates given. Existing slots there are replaced for those dates.

trackPlan.title: Track plan

range.title: Dates
range.note: Dates and times are in the station timezone ({zone}). Up to 7 days at once.

rebuild.note: A rebuild chooses the tracks of the planned hours again. Hours that have started keep their plan.

hours.title: Planned hours
hours.warningsNote: Warnings are shown for hours built since this panel was opened.
hours.empty: No planned hours on these dates. The plan covers the next 24 to 48 hours; later hours are built as the time comes.

trackPlan.noItems: No tracks are planned in this hour.

warnings.element_blocked_by_play_rules: Element {element}: play rules block every track, so the element is skipped.
warnings.element_tolerance_relaxed: Element {element}: no track fit the tolerance; one was chosen with a wider tolerance.
warnings.element_general_pool: Element {element}: no track of its playlists fit; one was taken from the whole library.
warnings.element_emergency: Element {element}: no track at all; the element is skipped and the emergency playlist covers it.
warnings.pool_track_refused: Segment {segment}: the pool track {track} breaks a separation or play rule and was skipped.
warnings.pool_empty: Segment {segment}: the filler pool is empty, so the default filler mode was used. Refill the pool.
warnings.filler_waiting: Segment {segment}: waits for the answer to a filler reminder.
warnings.gap_unfilled: Segment {segment}: a gap is left that no filler could close.
warnings.element_replaced: Element {element}: replaced in this hour by a rescheduled item.
warnings.reschedule_dropped: A rescheduled item could not be placed in this hour.

fillerReminders.title: Filler reminders
fillerReminders.answerNote: Choose a track for the short segment of “{clock}” at {hour}. The hour is rebuilt with it.
fillerReminders.answered: The answer is saved; the hour of “{clock}” is rebuilt.

list.title: What aired
list.empty: Nothing aired or was missed in this range.

missedItems.title: Missed items
missedItems.rescheduleNote: Choose a later planned hour for “{title}”. The hour is rebuilt around it, once; the clock does not change.
missedItems.noTargets: No planned hours are ahead yet. The plan is extended as time goes on.

status.failed: The item could not be placed in that hour. Try another hour or placement.

dismissDialog.title: Dismiss “{title}”?
dismissDialog.message: “{title}” will not be aired again. It stays in the played-tracks list as Not aired.

reasons.replaced: Another panel took over the live session.
reasons.no_audio: The live session ended: no audio reached the station.
reasons.dropout: The live session ended: the audio connection was lost.
reasons.shutdown: The live session ended because the backend stopped.

voice.title: Live voice
voice.insecure: The browser offers the microphone only when the panel is opened on localhost or over HTTPS. Open it that way to go live.
voice.note: Testing the microphone sends nothing to the air.
voice.ducking: While you are live, the music is lowered automatically to the ducking level set in

takeover.title: Take over the live session?
takeover.message: A live session is already running, from another panel or from this one before a reload. Taking over ends it and puts this microphone on air.

errors.denied: The browser was not allowed to use the microphone. Allow it in the site settings and try again.
errors.busy: The microphone is in use by another program.
errors.microphone: The microphone could not be opened.
errors.inputLost: The microphone was disconnected. Choose it again or another one.
errors.connection: The live connection could not be set up.

gain.title: Music gain
gain.label: Music gain
gain.note: Applies at once and stays until it is changed or the backend restarts; then the gain from the settings applies.
gain.unknown: The current gain is not known yet: the playout engine has not connected.

operationStatus.failed: Failed. The error message shows the reason.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.empty: The inbox is empty. Copy audio files into the {dir} folder inside the media folder on the station computer, then press Refresh.
inbox.more: The folder holds more files than are listed here.

form.title: Import the inbox
form.intro: Every file in the inbox becomes a track with this type and these playlists. Import songs and jingles as separate batches.

analyse.title: Analysis
analyse.intro: Analyse the tracks that have never been analysed. To check other tracks again, for example after changing the broadcast standard in Settings, select them in the library and press Analyse.

logs.title: Logs
logs.note: Files are named by their UTC date. Times are shown in the station timezone ({zone}).
logs.offsetLimit: Older entries of this file cannot be read here. Narrow the filters to see them.
